name: DisequalityDispersion.mul_pred_add_one_le_sq
typeText:
∀ (n : Nat),
  LE.le.{0} 1 n →
    LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} n (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} n 1)) 1) (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} n 2)

source.code:
theorem mul_pred_add_one_le_sq (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : n * (n - 1) + 1 ≤ n ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  nlinarith
